## Details

<a id="tune_ptrs"></a>
### [`tune_ptrs`](../../../../src/music/tunes.asm#L6) `$A029-$A10C`

*data*

Start of each tune, 114 words (tunes $00-$71). The sound request $80+n in $dd-$df starts tune n.

- **Read by:** [`music_tick`](tick.md#music_tick)

<a id="tune_57"></a>
### [`tune_57`](../../../../src/music/tunes.asm#L37) `$A10D-$A115`

*data*

Tune data: bytes $00-$bf are notes, $c0-$cf select a note length, $f0-$f9 are commands with 0-2 argument bytes.

- **Entry of:** [`tune_ptrs`](../../tables.md#tune_ptrs)

<a id="tune_58"></a>
### [`tune_58`](../../../../src/music/tunes.asm#L41) `$A116`

*data*

Tunes $58 and $59 are empty: only the end command $f2.

- **Entry of:** [`tune_ptrs`](../../tables.md#tune_ptrs)
